content: Kulu Negur, profet bunem, sain musei ado naab fire fire bun, tubuda tar wogõ fiyẽdin,
anĩ ere, gama idikeleya naa enidi bun, ĩ Naal bunem wogõ fadan, Naal ĩ ereb ereb ganan akorouf nigin Negurem igirnen, ĩ bunem saa teneub ado inon.

Naal ĩ Negur nẽ fula fiya medeĩya nẽ so fiya, ĩ Negur yogo gen bagai, in od totol ado bunem ereb ereb ganan megeir irou ifaref. Ĩ mosor lilik fiya anĩ age fel fen, saa ilun Negur Megeir Bagai ima biyalẽ ibodon.
Negur, Naal yana ifenen are engel yeneid wal fiya, age fiya bagai, Naal ĩ engel wal fediya.
Ere nigin, Negur ĩ yogon engel taka to eig ye irokenen,

content.text: “Õ neu Kesu,
gama aya õ Tamã wõ aul.”

content: Takag, Negur ĩ engel taka nigin to eig ye iron,

content.text: “Aya yogon Tama abodõf,
ĩ neu Kesu ibodõf.”

content: Takag, Negur ĩ yogon kesu matu tenebur ein irou isif sain bun, ĩ baban irok,

content.text: “Negur nẽ engel ganan ĩ seli dalouf.”
“Ĩ yogon engel yau gen wowã douf nigin inodif,
ĩ yogon kabĩ tamo yã bale gen wowã douf nigin inodif.”

content: Anĩ ere, Negur ĩ Naal nigin irok,

content.text: “O Negur, ogon tano gai gai ibodkalauf,
õ ogon tano tobonunã madur bagai bun lo wouf.
Õ tobonunã madur bagai nigin waũ laaf fen, tobonunã sane anĩ sese wedig,
anĩ nigin, Negur, ogon Negur kulĩya nẽ moul õ bun fi felen,
anĩ bunem, nẽ tã tar wal feid fen, ilun inenon.”
“O Odug, gariya bun õ teneub nẽ gariya kare won,
õ imam saa unon.
Idi fau inanakalauf, anĩ ere, õ fau ubodõf,
idi ganan kolos gen sanef ilauf.
Õ idi saket gen kori wediyouf,
idi kolos gen falei wediyouf.
Anĩ ere, õ ubodok gen ago ubodõf,
ogon sain to idikalauf.”

content: Negur ĩ yogon engel taka to eig ye irokenen,

content.text: “Imau biyalẽ ubod mog,
ogon kiwai tar
õ yẽ inoya nẽ sawa anouf.”

content: Age fiyauf are, engel idi ere? Idi uur Negur nẽ kabĩ daledig, tamo kayau isennẽya dalouf anidi disennẽdiyouf nigin Negurem idi sur fedidig.
